items.description: Laptop damage payment - cracked screen and lower-right corner impact damage
items.rationale: Covered under 2.6.1/2.6.2 (swerve in conveyance, struck door); screen and corner are one loss on one unit (2.6.3). Repair of screen plus housing would be about 1,150 per reference case 2, but 7.1.10 caps indemnity at the acquisition amount of an equivalent new unit (about 1,400) less salvage, so roughly 1,150-1,300 gross.
